reason: I buy to resell, so 21,000 IQD in fees on a 30,000 IQD item kills my margin before I even price it on the shelf. 13,000 IQD a kilo by air plus 8% is fine for one personal item, not for stock in quantity.
objection: The landed cost per piece is too high for resale, and there's no bulk or sea-cargo rate or volume discount mentioned. I'm also not sure 2 to 3 weeks will hold reliably when I promise customers dates.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk rate for 1688 orders, like a lower per-kilo price or sea shipping for big orders and a reduced buying fee above a set quantity, so my landed cost per piece drops to something I can resell at a profit.
